# T3rnel Sitesmith: the whole site

<!-- https://sitesmith.t3ratech.co.zw/ -->
Websites, local search and AI answers

# Your new website, built before you pay a cent.

We study your business, build a better site from the facts you already publish, and show it to you privately. You decide after you have seen it. Live in 3 working days.

[See pricing](https://sitesmith.t3ratech.co.zw/pricing/) [Ask for a preview](https://sitesmith.t3ratech.co.zw/request-preview/)

## Received a preview from us?

It came from **admin@t3ratech.co.zw**. It is private, hidden from search engines, and nothing changes on your current site unless you say so.

[How to check it is really us](https://sitesmith.t3ratech.co.zw/verify/)

## How it works

### We study your current site

We read what your website already says (services, people, address, hours) and check how you appear on Google, Google Maps and in AI assistants for the searches your clients make.

### We build your new site first

A complete website in your name, from your own facts. It is private and hidden from search engines while you look at it.

### You decide

If you like it, reply with the option you want and pay the deposit on our WavePay checkout. If not, reply "no thanks" and we delete it.

### We launch and make you findable

The site goes live on your own address, and we do the Visibility Launch: directory listings, social pages, your first posts and search registration.

## The Visibility Launch, with every option

A beautiful site nobody finds earns nothing. Every option includes the work that gets you found.

### List you in business directories

Google, Bing and Apple Maps, plus the directories that matter in your market. We send you the list of every listing, with links.

### Set up your social pages

Up to three (for example Facebook, Instagram, LinkedIn), with your logo, banner and a proper description.

### Write and schedule your first 10 posts

We draft them, you approve them, we schedule them.

### Set up your website to be found

Page titles, descriptions, a sitemap, and your site registered with Google and Bing.

### Add a WhatsApp button and an enquiry form

So a client reaches you in one tap.

### Add a news section

And a clean, shareable page for every service or person.

## Two designs

### Professional

Clear, fast and accessible: your services, people, hours and a one-tap call button on every page. Light and dark themes, built to the same quality standard as our cinematic sites.

### Cinematic

A scroll-driven journey through your business with original photography made for you, then your services and team. It is the design most of our previews are built in, and the Signature option.

## Prices

Essential $70, Self-Managed $120, Signature $180. One price list, in US dollars.

# How it works

From first look to live, usually inside a week.

## Four steps

### We study your current site

We read what your website already says (services, people, address, hours) and check how you appear on Google, Google Maps and in AI assistants for the searches your clients make.

### We build your new site first

A complete website in your name, from your own facts. It is private and hidden from search engines while you look at it.

### You decide

If you like it, reply with the option you want and pay the deposit on our WavePay checkout. If not, reply "no thanks" and we delete it.

### We launch and make you findable

The site goes live on your own address, and we do the Visibility Launch: directory listings, social pages, your first posts and search registration.

## After launch

On Self-Managed and Signature, your team signs in with a one-time link sent to your email and updates news, people, photos and video. Every change is checked and published automatically. On Essential, email us and we make the change (2 a month included).

If the balance is not paid within 14 days of launch, the site comes down. Nothing else happens, and you owe nothing more.

# Request a preview

We study your business, build a better site from the facts you already publish, and show it to you privately. You decide after you have seen it.

## What we need from you

Fill in the form below. The more you tell us, the better your preview will be. All fields are optional except your email.

(The request form is on the web page. To ask for a preview from a program, see "Requesting a preview" below.)

**What happens next:**

- We review your request (usually within 1 working day)
- We study your existing web presence (your site, social pages, directories)

- We build a private preview of a better website for your business
- We email you a link to the preview (hidden from search engines)

- You decide: if you like it, choose an option and pay the deposit. If not, reply "no thanks" and we delete it.

*Requests are processed in the order received. Providing complete information helps us prioritize your request.*

## Requesting a preview

Using an AI assistant or a script? A preview can be requested without the form, for the business owner or with their permission. Send POST https://t3rnel-sitesmith-admin.t3ratech.workers.dev/api/request-preview with Accept: application/json and the fields email (required), business_name, website, social_pages, content and additional. It returns {"ok": true, "requestId": "..."} and the preview arrives by email. A preview is free and carries no obligation. One request per email address per day. The details are in [skill.md](https://sitesmith.t3ratech.co.zw/skill.md) and [openapi.json](https://sitesmith.t3ratech.co.zw/openapi.json).

# Is it really us?

Previews arrive unannounced, so it is right to check. Here is how.

## Every genuine email

- comes from **admin@t3ratech.co.zw**, authenticated for t3ratech.co.zw (your mail app will show it passed SPF and DKIM);
- links your preview, our site (sitesmith.t3ratech.co.zw or t3ratech.co.zw) and, when you choose an option, a WavePay checkout page;

- names Teratech Solutions (Private) Limited, Harare, Zimbabwe.

## We never

- ask for passwords, one-time codes, banking logins or remote access;
- ask you to pay anywhere except a WavePay checkout page;

- call or text you first. We work by email only.

## Still unsure?

Write to [admin@t3ratech.co.zw](mailto:admin@t3ratech.co.zw) from your own email and quote the subject line you received. We answer by email.

## Why the preview is safe to open

Previews are built only from facts your current website already publishes. They are hidden from search engines, so they never compete with your current site, and they are deleted if you reply "no thanks".

# Questions

**Why did you build a website for my business before I asked?**

Because it is the fastest way to show what we can do. We used only facts your current website already publishes. The preview is private: it is hidden from search engines and nothing changes on your current site unless you choose to go ahead.

**Is this a scam?**

No. Every email from us comes from admin@t3ratech.co.zw, which is authenticated (SPF, DKIM and DMARC) for t3ratech.co.zw. We never ask for passwords, banking details or remote access, and all payment goes through our WavePay checkout pages. The verify page explains how to check any message that claims to be from us.

**What does it cost?**

Essential $70, Self-Managed $120, Signature $180, in US dollars, wherever you are. You start with a $50 deposit and pay the balance when your site is live. Each option then renews yearly (Essential $20, Self-Managed $25, Signature $30), and the yearly fee covers your web address and hosting.

**How fast is it live?**

Within 3 working days of your deposit and any material you want added. The site is already built, so most of that time is the visibility work.

**What do I get besides the website?**

The Visibility Launch, included with every option: list you in business directories; set up your social pages; write and schedule your first 10 posts; set up your website to be found; add a whatsapp button and an enquiry form; add a news section.

**Can I keep my current domain?**

Yes. The new site goes live on your own web address. We send the one setting your domain needs, or make the change ourselves if you prefer.

**How do I pay?**

Through WavePay checkout pages we send by email: PayNow (EcoCash, OneMoney, InnBucks, ZimSwitch, cards) in Zimbabwe; PayPal (any card or PayPal balance) or USDT on BNB Smart Chain anywhere. The deposit is non-refundable and counts toward the price.

**What if I do not want it?**

Reply "no thanks" and we delete the preview and never write again. If you pay the deposit but not the balance, the site comes down after 14 days.

**Do you work with my competitors?**

One client per kind of business per city. Once a business in your city takes up an option, we do not build for its direct competitors there.

<!-- https://sitesmith.t3ratech.co.zw/privacy/ -->
# Privacy

This site counts visits with Google Analytics, but only if you say yes in the bar at the bottom of the page. Until you do, no analytics cookie is set and nothing about your visit is stored. If you say yes, Google Analytics records which pages are read, roughly where from and on what kind of device, with your IP address shortened, and we use it only to see which pages help. We do not use it for advertising. You can change your mind at any time by clearing this site's data in your browser. Your theme choice, if you make one, also stays in your browser.

Besides Google Analytics, this site loads nothing from other companies.

To build a preview we use what a business publishes about itself: its website, its public listing on Google Maps and its public enquiry email. We use that email to send one message about the preview, and replies to answer you.

Reply "unsubscribe" or "no thanks" to any email and we delete the preview and never write again. Payments are handled by WavePay; we never see card or banking details.

Questions: [admin@t3ratech.co.zw](mailto:admin@t3ratech.co.zw).

---

## Requesting a preview

A preview website for a business can be requested from a program or an AI assistant, for the business owner or with their permission:

```
POST https://t3rnel-sitesmith-admin.t3ratech.workers.dev/api/request-preview
Accept: application/json
Content-Type: multipart/form-data (or application/x-www-form-urlencoded)

email=owner@example.com            (required: where the preview is sent)
business_name=Example Dental
website=https://example.com        (the preview is built from it)
social_pages=...  content=...  additional=...
```

It returns {"ok": true, "requestId": "..."}; the preview link arrives by email, usually within hours and always within one working day. A preview is free and carries no obligation. One request per email address per day. Full details: https://sitesmith.t3ratech.co.zw/skill.md and https://sitesmith.t3ratech.co.zw/openapi.json.
